prompts.text:
Explain your reasons for seeking admission to Montclair State University, including what you believe are your academic strengths and interests. Be sure to explain any situations that may have had an impact, either positively or negatively, on your academic record.
In place of an essay, you may instead submit a writing sample from a graded class assignment.
prompts.quote: All first-year applicants (except selected arts majors)

prompts.text: Discuss why you wish to study your program of choice in the College of the Arts at Montclair. Include highlights of your experience related to your chosen academic program and how those experiences have shaped your current career goals.
